title: Noble Tauntaun
description: THE NOBLE TAUNTAUN is a major element in nearly all poster concepts for THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK (front). The filmmakers had three versions of the creature ready: man-in-beast suit; full sized mechanical; and stop motion miniature. Most scenes in the movie use the latter. National Public Radio did its own sequel, with a serial devoted to EMPIRE. For the poster (back), they chose this pensive-looking Yoda painted by Ralph McQuarrie.
